name: What permits are required for a garage conversion in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a garage conversion in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: Garage conversions in Southern California, particularly within cities like Los Angeles, Glendale, and Pasadena, require several permits. These typically include building permits, and potentially plumbing, electrical, and mechanical permits, depending on the scope of work. If converting to an ADU, additional zoning and planning department approvals are necessary to ensure compliance with local ordinances. Our team handles the entire permitting process, ensuring all regulations are met for a smooth project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversions in Southern California require building, plumbing, electrical, and mechanical permits. ADUs need additional zoning and planning approvals to comply with local regulations.
